mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing Ptolemy’s model with planetary sightings was most worthwhile: it clarified that successful prediction does not by itself establish a physical cause.

leastWorthwhile.text: The geared model’s result was least substantive: it reiterated the distinction between representation and explanation without much detail about the mechanism.

surprise.text: The planetary archive inherited the earlier archive’s practice of recording dates and gaps, not its sightings themselves; that distinction sharpened my understanding of the combination.
